verdict: Leads growing and cost per lead falling, but Google spend needs fixing.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 131 leads at an average cost of $16.63 per lead, all driven by Meta — and the most recent 7 days showed the strongest efficiency of the period, with leads up 6% and cost per lead down 13%. Google Ads ran $502 in spend over the same window with zero recorded conversions, a confirmed spend leak that is being addressed now with conversion tracking repair and a targeting review. Separately, 103 leads entered your pipeline this period but zero converted to appointments or won opportunities, pointing to a stall in the intake process after the lead arrives — this is not an ads issue, and resolving it is the priority that unlocks the most near-term growth. You can expect Google to either begin returning measurable results or be restructured before the end of September, and pipeline intake improvements are in motion alongside that work.
